description:
About the company
 Our client is a consumer technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join a small engineering team to build and ship features across the web frontend and backend services of a consumer application. The work spans scalable infrastructure, data pipelines, experimentation and recommendation features, in a fast-paced and experimental setting.
 What you'll do
 - Scale backend infrastructure to keep pace with rapidly growing user data and image volume.
 - Build polished, responsive frontend experiences in React and Next.js.
 - Ship features through an A/B testing and experimentation pipeline.
 - Develop data pipelines for ingesting and processing large third-party catalogs, including ETL and orchestration.
 - Contribute to ranking and recommendation systems, including personalization and suggestions.
 - Deliver end-to-end features quickly in a highly experimental environment, working closely with the founder and a small group of engineers.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2 to 5 years of experience as a full stack engineer.
 - Prior experience at a startup or a notable technology company.
 - Proficiency in React, Next.js and Python.
 - A computer science degree from a top-ranked U.S. program.
 - Working understanding of AI models, including computer vision and recommendation systems.
 Bonus points
 - Experience building consumer-facing products at scale.
 - A design and product-focused mindset with a drive to build functional, attractive interfaces.
 - Customer focus and enthusiasm for turning user feedback into code.
 - Experience with Swift and iOS development.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 175,000 to 250,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
